suggested_fix.fix_text: The agent should not output 'None' if the extraction logic finds no matching element. Instead, it must print the raw HTML snippet of the suspected location or the full structure around the 'Number' key to aid debugging. Simply returning 'None' masks the failure state and prevents effective troubleshooting.

The agent executed the requested action (extraction) but produced a broken result ('None') without indicating why, halting progress. A better classification would be 'Code_Execution_Failure' or 'Robustness_Lack'.
